text: | sb_physical | production FG and consolidated gates | Use unallocated physical V for balances and attributed exchange vector A for burdens. Production opening raw/component stores and WIP plus external receipts plus old FG entering rework equals corresponding closing stores/WIP plus gross newly released transfer V_new plus old FG returned to FG plus all external outlets. V_new already contains Q_c and attached packages; do not add Q_c again. FG opening gross stock plus V_new plus true external returns plus old FG returned plus service component issues equals closing gross FG plus gross shipments plus old FG sent to rework plus actual external losses. Cancel paired internal legs in the combined gate. Reconcile total mass and Cr/O/Sb/Fe/Pb and each relevant element independently from actual phase/species evidence; one residual cannot fit two unknowns. Whole mixed outlets and source partitions are non-additive. X_in or X_out removes only an exactly duplicated OTHER term on the same side; never a stock or opposite-side flow. | `jrc-ilcd-2010` |

| sb_components | every real packaging container and attachment | For each concrete component k close opening_k + P_k + N_ext_k + ER_k + F_in_k = closing_k + grossS_k + EO_k + W_k + F_out_k at the same physical gate. Opening/closing includes empty stock, components attached to raw/WIP, attached FG and reusable stock without overlap. P means real purchases only. N_ext means all first external nonpurchase physical receipts including supplier-included packaging and first entrusted, borrowed or leased receipt. ER requires the same identified component to have an earlier external dispatch. These three ingress classes are mutually exclusive; opening stock cannot replace current receipts. Record actual material/form/type/direction and independently measured quantity for every event through its specific atomic receipt card/interface. Missing an actual interface makes that concrete package incomplete; do not just add a symbol or reuse a purchase UUID blindly. Internal issues/reuse cancel. grossS follows gross shipments, never Q or economic allocation. F_in_k/F_out_k are these independently measured and separately identified actual material/water/species or phase-transfer legs crossing this same component gate; exclude quantities already in P_k/N_ext_k/ER_k or grossS_k/EO_k/W_k. Include actual retained contamination or moisture changes without assuming their presence. Pair internal cross-ledger legs and cancel them only at the combined gate. Whole contaminated W_k remains one measured outlet with non-additive component/content partitions and one provider. A genuinely new retained-material input is still an input, not an X deduction; X removes only an exact OTHER duplicate on the same side. No reaction yield, water uptake or loss quantity is defaulted. | `jrc-ilcd-2010` |

Distinguish true purchase from all first nonpurchase external receipts and genuine returns; internally issued quantity is paired and cancels. Close each material at one gate; no guessed item kg. Collect actual change legs independently without overlap with receipt/outlet classes; preserve whole contaminated W once and its non-additive child accounts. | kg | each event and complete stocktake | full declared period including failures and Q0 | all included operations and stores at the actual sites | per 1 kg reference flow | calibration; raw logs; analyses; custody; supplier scope; independently checked balances |

| calc_component_closure | each physical component pool | opening_k + P_k + N_ext_k + ER_k + F_in_k = closing_k + grossS_k + EO_k + W_k + F_out_k; P is true purchase; N_ext is all first nonpurchase external physical receipts; ER has prior external dispatch; classify events mutually exclusively. Include all empty/raw/WIP/FG/reusable stocks once. Internal issues cancel and original manufacture is charged once independently of receipt classification. | event-specific material form type direction and measured kg; same-gate stocks; history; independently measured actual F_in_k/F_out_k and paired cross-ledger IDs | raw component balance and signed unresolved difference | `jrc-ilcd-2010` |

| vr_components | every physical component | Recalculate opening + P + N_ext + ER + F_in = closing + grossS + EO + W + F_out for each concrete material/form/type at one gate. P is purchase only; N_ext includes supplier-included and first entrusted/borrowed/leased receipts; ER requires original external dispatch. Events are disjoint. Opening does not replace current receipts; internal raw/WIP/FG issues/reuse cancel. Require actual specific receipt interface and measured kg for every event; missing interface makes that data package incomplete. Audit ownership/original cohort/inherited vector/provider-included manufacture and incremental rental/return service separately with one burden owner; no zero burden/new Q/credit inference. | `jrc-ilcd-2010` |

| vr_physical | production FG and consolidated gates | Apply the identical raw V gates in sb_physical and calc_physical. Independently verify total mass, each relevant element, actual phases/species and all water/heat legs; PM/COD/total-metal indicators are not specific chemical mass. Do not solve multiple unknowns with one residual. Whole outlets and disjoint source partitions are not additive; no allocation factor can close a missing physical leg. Only identical OTHER duplicates on the same side may be removed as X. | `jrc-ilcd-2010` |
